g.text: The native section cochain survives a change of path
Full parameter maps · closed comparison F = (A,B,R)
Two projection paths around one native map
Jₐ = Qₐ′(A Hₐ + R Qₐ)
J_b = Q_b′(A H_b + R Q_b)
U = Qₐ H_b; U′ = Qₐ′ H_b′
∂K = Jₐ − J_b − U′A + BU
K = U′(A H_b + R Q_b) − Jₐ H_b
|K| = −2; every original R-core is retained.
R(y) = f + z + 11v
Omitting the closed 11v term loses the value −77w.
The full cylinder retains R on its suspended row
Ξ(F)(Sy) = −XRy + SBy
q_Z(Xx + Sy + Yy₀) = Qx + y₀
h_Z(Xx) = XHx − SQx
(Dφ)₀→₈→₁₂(Sy) = 11w
The entire two-parameter differential sees the closed R term.
For degree r: |J|=r−1, |K|=r−2; the nonclosed terms are retained.
Only the Y-restriction kernel is contracted; the target remains.
Exact graded signs, whole Nat faces and native cochains: §68.
